run_flux_semantic_guidance_pipeline: run the FluxSemanticGuidancePipeline to generate images with semantic editing guidance from text prompts
encode_text_with_editing: encode text prompts with editing prompts and negative prompts for semantic guidance in the Flux pipeline
encode_flux_prompt: encode text prompts into T5 and CLIP embeddings for the Flux text-to-image generation pipeline
calculate_shift_parameter: calculate the shift parameter for timestep scheduling based on image sequence length in the Flux scheduler
retrieve_timesteps_from_scheduler: retrieve timesteps from a diffusion scheduler with support for custom timesteps or sigmas
